semiconductor_relevance: High — Thomas Cable specializes in cleanroom cable solutions critical for semiconductor manufacturing processes.
summary: Thomas Cable Co., Ltd. provides customized clean cable moving systems designed for ultra-precision cleanroom environments, particularly in semiconductor and display manufacturing. Their flagship product, WOWFLEX, features a patented block-type assembly structure and is tailored to meet specific customer requirements, ensuring reliability in particle-sensitive applications.

regional_presence.Korea: Thomas Cable has developed Korea's first patented technology for cleanroom cable solutions and sources all components domestically.
